notes: The substantival article takes he that and heads on the pronoun, while the predicate participle keeps its own English together with the supplied copula (rules 41 and 20).
ha-yom is fused to the adverbial to day headed on the noun, as in 1SA.4.3 (rule 30).
meh takes only How here, because a verb (haya, rendered went) stands in the clause to carry the predication, unlike the verbless clauses of 1SA.4.6 and 1SA.4.14.
